layout.description: Native layout object, never quoted JSON.

key.description: Exact element key in the selected draft.

field.description: State JSON Pointer, e.g. /position. Omit or use "" for a scalar root; not /value unless it is an actual member of the State.
Overrides the card's field for this item.

words.description: Custom text for Boolean fields only.

meter.description: Live numeric reading with history and an optional second live reading, all from the power Entity's Device.

oneOf.description: One live numeric reading. trend adds history over a window.

entity_id.description: Entity with a numeric State field.

range.description: Only for a numeric field with declared bounds.

oneOf.description: Numeric history for up to 8 Entity fields over one window, on one axis. Use it to see how readings changed over time. Held settings such as a thermostat target draw as steps, so a target and a room temperature can share a chart.

series.description: Distinct Entity fields in one canonical unit; the Entities may have different types. The same Entity may appear twice with different fields. An item's field overrides the card's field; a scalar-root Entity cannot override it, so when fields differ give every series its own field and omit the card's.

compare.description: Draw today from midnight over the last 7 days' range for each time of day, to answer whether today is unusual. Needs exactly one series and window 24h.

oneOf.description: Current readings of 2–12 Entities sorted from highest to lowest, to answer which is warmest or which draws most. Hearth chooses the drawing; there is no style key.

rows.description: Distinct numeric Entity fields in one canonical unit; the Entities may have different types.

range.description: Also show each row's minimum and maximum over this window.

oneOf.description: When one numeric field is usually high or low: its mean in three-hour blocks for each of the last 7 days. For when a yes/no field was true, use WeekPattern.

entity_id.description: Entity with a numeric State field.

oneOf.description: How much of a window a numeric field spent below, between, and above one or two thresholds, to answer how much of the time it was in range.

entity_id.description: Entity with a numeric State field.

thresholds.description: One or two strictly ascending thresholds in the field's CANONICAL unit, not the household display unit. Read the field's canonical unit and value first: for example hearth.temperature/v1 is stored in milli-degrees Celsius, so 20.5 °C is 20500.

oneOf.description: How long a yes/no field was true in each hour of the last 24 hours (period hour) or each of the last 7 days (period day), such as how long the heater ran. For a Boolean field only.

entity_id.description: Entity with a Boolean State field.

style.description: columns: one labelled bar per period. ledger: one row per period, read like a table.

oneOf.description: One live yes/no or text reading. For a binary sensor, supply words when its meaning is known.

entity_id.description: Entity with a Boolean or text State field.

oneOf.description: Up to 12 mixed live readings in one card.
Follows all of a Device's readable Entities live.
When up to 12 yes/no or text fields changed over one window.

style.description: Lanes compare rows on one axis; ledger shows row totals; feed shows changes newest first.

rows.description: Distinct Boolean or text Entity fields.

oneOf.description: When one yes/no field was true, hour by hour, over the last 7 days.

entity_id.description: Entity with a Boolean State field.

oneOf.description: Tap-to-toggle tile bound to the root of a hearth.power/v1 Entity, labeled with the Device name. Use a Grid of ToggleTiles for quick switches. Ordinary toggle tiles have no metric and no sparkline. For a metering plug, metric binds one explicit numeric entity_id and field with a window (24h unless asked otherwise), shared by the displayed value and sparkline. Prefer discovered electrical power in watts, not cumulative energy; the editor can change that source. metric.detail adds a separately bound reading such as total energy. Every metric source must belong to the power Entity's Device; do not guess a source by name or list order.
1–12 distinct hearth.power/v1 Entities, each labeled with its Device name.

all_off.description: Offer a native Turn all off button.

oneOf.description: Current outdoor conditions from a weather station. It words conditions from the rain rate and wind speed but shows no feels-like or dew point.
Rain rate with optional storm and period totals. Every rain counter is in mm, so match each storm, day, week, month, or year slot to the sensor named for that period, such as Daily Rain for day.

storm.description: The station's own storm rain counter in mm, never a sum of the rate.

totals.description: Bind the station's own counters in mm, never sums of the rate.

oneOf.description: Sustained wind speed with optional gust, wind_direction, and max_gust.
A hearth.pressure/v1 Entity; the card states its three-hour tendency.

entity_id.description: Choose the relative or absolute pressure Entity that matches the request.

oneOf.description: Modeled hourly or daily forecast periods, not station readings.

entity_id.description: An hourly or daily forecast Entity, not a station sensor.

oneOf.description: For a Device of kind air-purifier. Bind fan_mode, fan_level, display, child_lock, and filter_life when the Device has a matching Entity. Identify display and child_lock by their Entity names (Display, Child lock); never guess, and omit a role you cannot identify. Every bound Entity must belong to the power Entity's Device. Use layout card on its own or in a dashboard, and layout tile in a Grid of quick switches.

pm25.description: PM2.5 sensor in µg/m³. Use a distinct Entity from the same Device for each role.

fan_mode.description: Enum with 2 to 5 modes, such as auto and sleep.

fan_level.description: Enum whose choices are 1 to N, N from 2 to 10.

oneOf.description: For a hearth.cover/v1 Entity, such as a garage door or shade, bound to the Entity's root and labeled with the Device name. Use layout card on its own or in a dashboard, and layout tile in a Grid of quick switches.

confirm_open.description: Opening asks for a second press unless this is false. Defaults to true; omit it for garage doors and doors. Set it false only when the user says the cover is a shade, blind, or similar.

oneOf.description: For a hearth.thermostat/v1 Entity, bound to its root. It shows the targets the current mode uses with −/+ controls, the mode and activity, inside temperature and humidity, and Mode and Fan controls.

For a hearth.mediaplayer/v1 Entity, bound to its root. Layout card shows track details, artwork, a timeline, and supported playback and volume controls; layout tile in a Grid is a compact play/pause control. Grouped speakers cannot be controlled.
Sets a TimeSeries or TimeInRange window, or a Ranking range. A TimeSeries with compare keeps its 24h window.
